optionsPrivacyBody.message: Local Time Everywhere runs entirely on your device. It reads text on the hosts listed above for the sole purpose of converting zoned times. No page content, browsing history, or profile data is ever sent anywhere. The only network request happens when you enter a license key, and only the key itself is sent.
